zh|ja|d2babc06e2d49a7f8406.text: 除了招聘之外，有很多负责人觉得自己无法胜任核心的人力资源职责，因为他们加入公司后要负责处理询问。人工智能代理是一种可以自主执行日常任务的人工智能，例如调整时间表和响应查询。另一方面，最终的通过/失败判断和评估必须由人类来做出。在这篇文章中，我们将解释人力资源和招聘中可以自动化的任务、好处、注意事项以及实施的3个步骤。读完这本书，你将能够理清留给公司的任务和留给别人的决定，并能够决定第一步。

en|ja|fb44017cade55de67ba4.text: Utilize AI agents for human resources and recruitment! Four tasks that can be automated and things to keep in mind

en|ja|d2babc06e2d49a7f8406.text: In addition to recruiting, there are many people in charge who feel that they are unable to handle the core human resources duties because they are responsible for handling inquiries after joining the company. An AI agent is an AI that can autonomously perform routine tasks such as adjusting schedules and responding to inquiries. On the other hand, the final judgment of pass/fail and evaluation must be made by humans. In this article, we will explain the tasks that can be automated in human resources and recruitment, the benefits, points to note, and the 3 steps for implementation. After reading this book, you will be able to sort out the tasks that will be left to your company and the decisions that will be left to others, and will be able to decide on the first step.
